title: Acceptance computation for the access machine
statement: For every Boolean mode and Boolean word $y$, there exist natural numbers $k,p$ such that the initial configuration on input $y$, in the scan-reading state, has a finite safe computation path to a halting configuration whose output is the indicator of whether $y$ belongs to the language of pairs $(z,r)$ satisfying the access-value predicate for that mode.
